title: Goodreads Audiobook Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goodreads:audiobook
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by shelf
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Goodreads audiobook data has stopped arriving for a given shelf.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per shelf and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your Goodreads audiobook feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
